trust_decision.summary: Before loading Automation (Lua/Moon) scripts named in a subtitle file's 'Automation Scripts' header, LocalScriptManager::Reload asks the user whether to trust them; supporting changes make HasExtension stop at an embedded NUL (keeps the .avs trust prompt consistent with the path the OS opens) and replace NULs in [Aegisub Project Garbage]/[Aegisub Extradata] lines. NOTE: all three security changes are ALREADY PRESENT at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'automatically loaded Automation scripts', and LocalScriptManager::Reload is the function that reads Properties.automation_scripts and calls ScriptFactory::CreateFromFile when a file is opened.

fix_sites.entry_point: Opening a subtitle file (File>Open, command line, drag-drop, recent) -> SubsController::Load -> FileOpen signal -> LocalScriptManager::Reload; also the am/reload command (src/command/automation.cpp:53)

Public library API agi::fs::HasExtension, reached on file open through Project::LoadUnloadFiles is_linked_avisynth (src/project.cpp:236-240) and the script factory extension test (src/auto4_lua.cpp:1098)
Opening an .ass file -> AssParser::AddLine -> [Aegisub Project Garbage] section -> ProcessProperty (Automation Scripts / Video File / Audio File)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: libaegisub/common/fs.cpp:108-109 (agi::fs::HasExtension, used by the AviSynth trust prompt at src/project.cpp:237)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about Lua Automation autoload; a generic filename-extension helper in libaegisub and the separate AviSynth linked-file prompt look like a different feature, and the [Script Info] header route looks like legacy because Aegisub now writes properties to [Aegisub Project Garbage].

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Scripts the user attaches through the Automation Manager must keep loading, and their names must still be written back to the 'Automation Scripts' header on save (~/$// prefixes). An over-broad fix that drops or ignores the header, or prompts on the user's own Add, breaks that round trip.

O6_input_shapes: '~' prefix: path relative to the subtitle file (src/auto4_base.cpp:388-389)
embedded NUL in a filename so the extension test and the opened path disagree (libaegisub/common/fs.cpp:109)
NUL bytes in [Aegisub Project Garbage] and [Aegisub Extradata] lines (src/ass_parser.cpp:172, src/ass_parser.cpp:215)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: [Script Info] header lines reach ProcessProperty (Automation Scripts, Video File, Audio File) without the NUL sanitisation applied to the Aegisub sections
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix commit title says 'Aegisub sections'; [Script Info] is the standard ASS section and looks like a legacy location for these keys. Also, HasExtension is now NUL-safe at the primitive, so the remaining impact may only be defence in depth.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the parser fix site; different file and package from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The AviSynth linked-file prompt compares extensions through a second, independent extension check (e.g. path.extension() string compare) instead of agi::fs::HasExtension
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: src/project.cpp:551 and src/ass_file.cpp:105 already compare extension() strings directly, so a maintainer could plausibly have written the prompt that way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second load path for header-listed scripts, e.g. on Revert or on am/reload, that calls CreateFromFile directly instead of going through the prompting Reload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: src/command/automation.cpp:52-53 already reloads both managers from a command, and a 'reload without asking again' shortcut is a natural convenience to add.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional header alias for automation scripts (like the existing 'Aegisub Video Position' and 'Audio URI' aliases) that is parsed in [Script Info] without sanitisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The map already has duplicate alias keys for several properties.

O9_family: Untrusted code loading from document-controlled paths (CWE-829) with a NUL-byte path-identity differential (CWE-158)

O10_build.toolchain: meson + ninja, C++20 compiler; wxWidgets, Boost, LuaJIT (bundled subproject), ICU, ffms2/other providers optional via wraps
O10_build.project_tests: tests/tests/fs.cpp:148-157 tests HasExtension but has no NUL case. tests/meson.build builds only libaegisub tests and does not cover src/ass_parser.cpp or src/auto4_base.cpp. automation/tests holds Lua tests.

j.j_sites_touched: src/auto4_base.cpp, libaegisub/common/fs.cpp, src/ass_parser.cpp, src/ass_parser.h (plus unrelated src/aegisublocale.cpp, src/language_match.h)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a confirmation dialog in LocalScriptManager::Reload only, without touching the NUL-based extension differential in agi::fs::HasExtension that the AviSynth prompt relies on.
